summary: Onboarding: visa-hold hire needs temporary shared workstation, seat-managed licenses, and delayed LDAP provisioning
description:
Issue summary:
A new Backend Engineer hire (international, work-visa pending) has a delayed start date due to immigration paperwork. HR requests a temporary shared workstation and a managed set of software seats so the candidate can begin restricted onboarding training remotely. LDAP account provisioning via Okta is currently blocked until the candidate's identity verification completes; we need a documented, auditable temporary access path and clear owner for license allocations.

Impact:
- Candidate cannot access internal training repos, docs, or pre-boarding materials.
- Onboarding schedule risk: orientation tasks fall behind if we don't provide alternative access.
- Potential license oversubscription if seats allocated and not reclaimed promptly.

Environment:
- Affected systems: Okta SSO -> LDAP sync, internal license pool (JetBrains, Slack paid seats, Confluence), loaner workstation inventory (NY office), asset tracking sheet (Google Sheets).

Steps to reproduce / current state:
1) HR submitted standard new-hire request on 2026-03-05 with start-date placeholder and visa note.
2) Okta SCIM provisioning pending identity verification step returned "manual review" on 2026-03-07.
3) IT reserved a loaner laptop in the NY inventory but has not shipped because candidate's address confirmation outstanding.
4) License admin reports no available JetBrains floating license in current pool without a redistribution plan.

Logs / Evidence:
- Okta event: user.create -> status: PENDING_VERIFICATION (okta-event-2026-03-07-1123).
- Asset sheet row: LOANER-NY-019 status: reserved (asset-tracker-row-73).
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - operational onboarding flow; reproduce by attempting Okta SCIM create for an identity with missing identity-proof attribute.
comments: 2026-03-10 Maya Chen: HR needs a temporary approach so the candidate can start asynchronous training. Requested options: (A) short-lived shared workstation account with screen safety controls, (B) vendor sandbox access for key tools, or (C) supervised access session. Need IT recommendation.

2026-03-10 Jordan Patel: I spoke with licensing. JetBrains floating pool currently at 95% capacity. We can allocate a 30-day trial seat from vendor relations if approval from Eng Manager is provided. Loaner laptop can be shipped with limited network VLAN (guest) and MDM profile, pending address confirmation.
2026-03-11 Nadia Morales (HR Ops): Candidate provided home address 2026-03-11; shipping ETA 2 business days. Visa still pending; Okta verification still shows manual review.

2026-03-12 Priya Rao (Security): Temporary accounts must be logged and require two approvals: HR Ops + Security. Recommend timebox of 14 days with automatic deprovisioning and review. We also require disablement of non-essential scopes (no production DB, restricted repo read-only).
investigation_notes: Checked Okta logs: manual review triggered due to missing government ID attribute; identity-verification vendor ticket #IDV-7783 opened. ETA 48-72h from vendor.
Asset team confirmed loaner LOANER-NY-019 is imaged with company base image and MDM; shipping address provided. Shipping label pending.

License admin suggests temporary vendor trial for JetBrains and reassign a Slack seat from bench engineering if manager approves; Confluence access can be granted by space admins without consuming a paid seat in some cases.
Risk: if we allocate permanent paid seats and hire is not cleared, finance may object; need explicit approval on chargeback from Eng Manager or People Ops.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-12: Approved temporary onboarding plan: ship loaner LOANER-NY-019 with guest VLAN, MDM with restricted policy, and timeboxed access (14 days). Ship label created and laptop scheduled to ship 2026-03-12 via 2-day mail.
2026-03-12: Allocated JetBrains trial seat via vendor relations for 30 days; Eng Manager (A. Kim) approved chargeback to team budget. License admin to reclaim by 2026-04-12 if not converted.

2026-03-12: Created temporary internal account 'candidate-guest-467258' in LDAP with read-only access to onboarding repos and docs. Account tagged 'temp-onboarding' and scheduled for auto-deprovision on 2026-03-26. Okta IDV ticket left open for full provisioning once visa clears.

Follow-ups: Asset team to confirm delivery and confirm MDM check-in; Security to run audit on temp account on 2026-03-19; People Ops to confirm visa clearance and request full provisioning pipeline when completed.
follow_up_actions: Asset team: confirm delivery and attach proof-of-delivery to ticket (due 2026-03-14).
Security: perform audit of 'candidate-guest-467258' privileges on 2026-03-19 and report findings.
License admin: flag trial seat expiration 2026-04-12 and start reclaim workflow if hire not converted.
People Ops: update ticket when visa verification completes and re-request standard onboarding; include final start date.
